Output: infected shapes recolored red (2), original red cell becomes black (0), uninfected shapes keep color, rest unchanged.

Subtle: diagonal neighbor counts (abs dr==1 and abs dc==1). Orthogonal neighbor. Jump over one black cell (straight, distance 2, middle BG=0).
